cx_below:
This is the place to find Amaco EXCEL Kilns on sale. Amaco kilns are recommended for ceramics. We are an authorized dealer of Amaco top loading kilns & kits.

Some of our favorite Amaco kilns are listed below. We offer the complete line so please call us toll-free at 888-774-2529 to order any Amaco Kiln not shown below.

These top loading kilns & kits are precision manufactured with only top quality components to assure years of service. And they include many standard features that are extra on other round kilns.

NOW AVAILABLE -- EZ-Lift spring-assisted hinge for Excel 10 and 12-sided kilns! The EZ-Lift makes the lid lighter for easier opening and closing while making your Excel kiln safer by reducing the risk of sudden lid drops. An EZ-Lift Upgrade Kit is also available as an add-on to existing 10 and 12-sided Excel kilns.

The general features of Excel kilns include:

  • Modular design - independent sections allow for one-person moving and easy brick and element replacement
  • Premium refractory firebrick - made from the highest quality materials, carefully cut and grooved for precise fit.
  • Sealed, dust-free lids with full floating hinges to allow for proper expansion and contraction during firing
  • Two-position, reinforced steel bar -- Standard on all Excel kilns including models with EZ-Lift -- secures lid while loading and unloading
  • Reversible slabs - extend the life of the Amaco kiln
  • High quality Kanthal A-1 elements
  • Stainless steel jackets of superior strength allow for further kiln expansion during firing
  • Choice of infinite control switches or Select FireTM computer control (Models EX-1099SF and 1266SF available with Select FireTM only)
  • Corrosion resistant lug connectors that require only a screwdriver to replace elements
  • Steel stand with no-mar rubber feet
  • 7-foot power cord with NEMA plug (except EX-1099SF, which is direct wire)
  • Two-year warranty
